dataList.content:
I see that you are having some trouble coming to an agreement amongst yourselves.
你们好像也无法轻易做出决定。
dataList.place:
Ahab's Office
亚哈的办公室

dataList.content:
That is quite understandable. It should be clear as day that the answer is right before your eyes. My offer is perfect for your present, rather desperate, situation.
当然，只是稍微想一想，也能知道我提出的条件全都是你们迫切需要的，而且过于切合你们的现状了。

But that is the whims of fate! These seemingly implausible, coincidental opportunities are the threads of fate weaving the path ahead for us!
但是，正因为那些令人吃惊的机遇如此偶然，才会被称为命运！

You must first learn to be someone who grips their destiny when it presents itself. It is common wisdom among every seafarer.
命运来临的时候要先学会把握住。这里的水手们都知道这个道理。

Ugh...
唔……

Sinclair shuddered a little.
辛克莱微微颤抖。

A lot has happened. Various moments of past 'coincidences' must have passed before every Sinner's eyes.
那些近在眼前的偶然，比如夹在其他船之间差点变成残渣。

When we were almost sandwiched between two ships, when we encountered those floating Mermaids on a deserted ship,
或是在偶然发现的船上遇到的悬挂着的人鱼，抑或是偶然遇到的浪潮中出现的鲸和它的副产物……

When we fought a Whale and its byproducts that came with the Waves...
所有这些偶然的瞬间，都与罪人们擦肩而过。

You and your arrogant, all-knowing speeches haven't changed one bit.
你的说话方式全部都如预料一般，完全看不到有一点变化的痕迹。

Don't delude yourself. I'm not joining hands with you ever again. Even now I can't wait to chew you up and tear you apart.
不要随便误会。我可完全没有想跟你一起行动的想法。我现在就只想生吃了你。

Hahaha! What face! What words! The girl has finally learned how to speak like a proper seadog worth her salt! Haven't you, Ishmael?
哈哈哈！真不错啊，你变得能够以出色的表情说出像水手一样的话了，以实玛利！

Didn't think you'd remember my name.
没想到你还会记得我的名字。

How could I not?
我怎么会忘记呢？

I heard your voice moments before the Whale swallowed me whole. The echoes of your voice calling my name, scattering to the winds amidst the desolation. Hah. I can hear it clearly, as though it happened but a day ago.
就在我被这头鲸吞噬之前……你在沉船的碎片之间撕心裂肺地呼喊我的名字。哈。就像发生在昨天一样，那声音仍然清晰地萦绕在耳边。

Even for a brief moment, through the tempest, our eyes met. And I peered into the depths of your heart.
那时，我看到了你的眼神，只是刹那间，我就理解了你心中的一切。

Into the depths of your true desire.
你真正渴望的是什么。

Ahab strode toward Ishmael.
亚哈缓缓地靠近以实玛利。

Ishmael stood her ground. She glared at the old woman with bloodshot eyes.
以实玛利似乎连躲都没想躲，只是用充血的眼睛盯着那个人。

So I'll give you what you want.
所以，我会给你你想要的。

Her voice was low... yet personal. Honest.
声音虽然暗淡……但却真诚。

Huh. Let's see what kind of crap you come up with this time.
呵，又说什么胡言乱语呢？

Because what I want...
我想要的是……

... Is my heart.
是我的心脏。

Ishmael. Listen well. I am... the first and the only person who watched the birth of your life's greatest wish.
我说啊，以实玛利。我是……第一个，也是唯一一个目击你人生最大愿望诞生时的样子的人。

There was an awakening deep within you. A hateful obsession, screaming and thrashing with frenzy so that you may one day gut me yourself.
那时在你内心中诞生的唯一的执念，以狂怒的视线与吼叫毫不留情地刺向了我。

That very desire is what has brought you before me, past the trials and tribulations the world has thrown in your way. Am I wrong?
你大概是只抱着那个想法才一直坚持到这里的吧？

The Golden Bough they seek? You don't give a shit about that. Of course you don't.
他们在找的金枝？你根本不在乎那种东西。你当然不在乎。

My very heart is your Golden Bough, your plunder, the treasure you so desperately seek at the end of your journey.
对你来说，我的心脏才是金枝。它既是宝箱，又是金币。

I knew that, deep inside, you were still a sailor and a harpooneer. An excellent one at that.
我知道的。你现在仍然是优秀的水手和鱼叉手。

From the moment of our reunion to now, you've been stabbing me over and over again in your head. And not once have you averted your eyes.
从第一次和我眼神接触开始，你就一直在用充满强烈怨恨的视线刺向我，不是吗？你的视线甚至从未有过一刹那的偏移。

And what a harpooneer that makes you! Were I a Whale, I would have willingly given you my heart to kill.
果然你最适合当鱼叉手！如果我是鲸，肯定会毫不犹豫地为你献出心脏。

You'll give me your heart...
你说你会……交出心脏。

You know better than anyone that I do not lie, Ishmael! You know where the bow of my accumulated passion has set course to!
那句话没有半点虚假，你不是最清楚的吗，以实玛利！你一定知道束缚我的这份渴求，会将我导向何方吧！

Help me destroy this Whale's heart...!
只要我能粉碎这头鲸的心脏……！

And I, Captain Ahab, shall willingly give you my life.
那我就会十分乐意地，将我的生命献给你。

It matters not the manner in which you end me. I will accept it all gladly.
我不在乎你以什么方式杀掉我。我全部都会接受。

Haah...
哈……

Ahab snatches Ishmael's harpoon, and brings it close to her throat.
亚哈握住以实玛利的捕鲸枪，将其对准了自己的脖子。

Now! Do you not wish to tear open my arteries?
来呀！难道你不想马上割断我的动脉吗？

Allow me to make this task even easier for you. Shall I turn my neck so that my veins are plain to see?! All of this is yours... as long as I can achieve my goal.
只要我能达成我的目标，你随便这么做！为了能让动脉被看得更清楚，我会亲切地露出脖子给你看的。

Oh, what a keen harpoon you have whetted! I can imagine the nights you've spent sharpening it, drawing a picture of my painful demise. You must have felt it—the call of destiny, your fate! Just as I have!!!
看看这被打磨锋利的鱼叉！你必定是一边想着无论如何都要将我痛苦地杀死一边将其磨利的吧！你一定是感受到了——命运的召唤，你的使命！就像我一样！！！

No one on this earth understands you better than I do, Ishmael! I know that very longing, that very burning hatred that consumes your days!
我比任何人都能理解你！那盈满悲切的内心，那充满憎恨的日子！

Yeah... You're right. I'm barely holding myself back from tearing into your arteries.
是的……即使是现在，我也只能勉强忍住把你撕碎的冲动。

Yet you do not act.
但是你没这么做。

Because even now, even as the tip of your razor-sharp harpoon tickles the fuzz on my neck, you know the truth so well.
因为你太清楚了，即使是在捕鲸枪正划过我脖子上的汗毛的这一瞬间也一样！

That you are still too weak to kill me.
想要杀我，你还太弱了。

How pitiful, yet how clever... The girl knows her place.
虽然很可怜，但也挺聪明嘛……你这不是很清楚自己的斤两么。

And that cleverness serves you well. A foolish sailor would not have accepted this very generous offer of mine.
真是太好了，你不是那种把握不住突然到来的机会的笨船员。

As long as I can kill the Pallid Whale with my two hands... I care not about what happens next.
只要我能杀死白鲸，用我的双手终结它的生命……之后我怎么样都无所谓。

My heart is yours to harpoon, Ishmael.
贯穿那唾手可得的心脏，以实玛利。

I will be made complete at that very moment. What happens afterward... I could not care less.
我的人生会在那个时候圆满。之后再发生什么我都不会在意。

Ha... Haha... Ha...
哈……哈哈……哈……

Ishmael laughed and laughed.
以实玛利笑个不停。

She did not fight back with her biting tongue, nor did she sharply and rationally criticize the Captain's words as she did ours.
没有像对待我们那样吐出辛辣的讽刺，也没有用冷静和理性的批判来面对。

She laughed and laughed and laughed, glaring straight into Ahab's eyes.
她用目光紧盯着亚哈的眼睛，只是张大嘴巴笑个不停。

Yes... I like the look in your eyes.
好啊，不错的眼神啊……

I can already see it. In fact, I may as well have already heard your decision from that look.
我看到你这样子，就已经清楚你的回答了。我几乎都能在脑海中清晰地听到了。

Yeah... Enjoy your last voyage, Ahab.
是啊……希望你享受你最后的航行，亚哈。

And whatever it takes, survive to the end of this voyage, until you destroy the Whale's heart.
然后，你一定要不惜一切代价的活下去，直到那颗心脏被击碎为止。

And I'll happily destroy you the moment you are made complete.
我会欢欣雀跃地杀死那个人生已圆满的你。

Ha! Ahahahaha!!
啊哈，啊哈哈哈！！

YES! Now I see the eyes of a proper seadog! Finally, conviction burns within your eyes!
没错，有着目标的水手，就该有那样的眼神啊！

I shall not disappoint, Ishmael. Allow my heart to beat like the very tempest, allow my heart to bleed hotter than the boiling blood of the Lava Whale. So that it may be a target worthy of your harpoon.
我不会让你失望，以实玛利。我的心脏将比那熔岩鲸搏动得更加剧烈，其中流淌出的热血也会更加鲜红炽热，更有被你的鱼叉贯穿的价值。

HA! HAHAHAHA!!
哈、哈哈哈！！

A sense of overwhelming dread emanated from the pair's mad laughter. Neither I nor the other Sinners dared to intrude.
这两个人面对面大笑的样子，流露出一种恐怖的氛围，让我觉得无论是自己还是罪人们，都难以介入其中。

Their laughters were very much alike.
这两人的笑声太过相似。

To the point where I wasn't sure which belonged to Ishmael and which belonged to Ahab.
以至于，我甚至开始分不清哪个才是以实玛利的笑声，哪个又是亚哈的笑声。

What I was thinking then... I'm not really sure.
我当时的想法到底是怎样的……我无法确定。

It wasn't like we had any other choice, but...
虽然除此以外也没有其他合适的办法，但我也许……

... maybe I was hoping that Ishmael would refuse the offer.
并不希望以实玛利接受那个提案。

So you're joining us for the jour...ney to the heart?
听说你决定加入，去心脏的航行？

Ain't that... nice. It's encouraging to have you lively-look...ing fellas along for the ride! Not a hint of that pale mem...brane to be seen on yous.
和身上看不到一点白色的，精神饱满的人们一起踏上航程，真让人觉得踏实不少啊。

Oh, speaking of which... How are you all so... okay?
啊……说起来，你们是怎么一点事都没有的？

How come the Pallid Wha...le's got no effect on an...y of you?
你们是怎么做到，丝毫不受这白鲸的影响的呢？

Curious, Starbuck asked.
斯达巴克饶有兴致地问道。

Forsooth, that is— Mmmph?!
那是因为！唔……？！

... It's a long story. We just happened to get lucky... and I'll leave it at that.
……就是会有这样的情况啊。大概是我们运气好吧。

Gregor cut in and blocked Don Quixote's mouth.
格里高尔适当地岔开了话题。顺便堵上了堂吉诃德的嘴。
